children: Rising crude prices and renewed inflation concerns are weighing on gold as investors brace for the Federal Reserve’s policy decision later this week.

Spot gold prices slipped below the $4,300-an-ounce mark around 2:50 pm IST on Monday, extending losses after the precious metal had already declined for three consecutive weeks. Gold fell further to around $4,290.5 an ounce, well below its recent August-September highs.

The retreat comes despite gold’s strong performance over the past year, with prices still up about 16.6 percent. The metal had climbed above $4,600 an ounce in recent weeks, leaving it vulnerable to profit-taking as investors reassess the outlook for interest rates and inflation.

A fresh surge in crude oil prices (currently standing at $102.62 a barrel) has added to the pressure. Crude prices moved towards four-month highs on Monday after Saudi Arabia shut its key East-West pipeline following drone attacks. The disruption, alongside wider supply and shipping risks stemming from the Middle East conflict, has revived concerns that higher energy costs could keep global inflation elevated.

That has strengthened expectations of a more hawkish Federal Reserve. Markets are now pricing in roughly a 90 percent probability of a 25-basis-point rate hike on Wednesday, according to Reuters. Higher interest rates tend to weigh on gold because the non-yielding asset becomes less attractive relative to interest-bearing investments.

The latest US inflation data has reinforced those concerns. Consumer prices rose 0.4 percent in August, following a 0.1 percent increase in July, while annual inflation stood at 3.4 percent. Core CPI, which excludes food and energy, increased 0.3 percent in August.

Meanwhile, hopes for a diplomatic breakthrough in the Middle East have weakened after a planned meeting involving Iran and Gulf states was postponed. The uncertainty has kept oil prices elevated and added another layer of inflation risk for central banks.

In India, MCX gold futures were trading at Rs 1,52,655 per 10 grams, down Rs 129 from the previous close of Rs 1,52,784. The contract moved between an intraday low of Rs 1,50,600 and a high of Rs 1,53,836.

title: Gold slips below $4,300 as oil surge fuels Fed rate-hike bets
